text: **Hint 1:** Consider how L1 regularization affects the coefficients in a linear model. L1 regularization, also known as Lasso regularization, tends to drive some coefficients to zero, effectively performing feature selection.\n\n**Hint 2:** Analyze the impact of the regularization term $\lambda(\hat{\theta}_1 + \hat{\theta}_2)$ on the objective function. The regularization term is added to the loss function to penalize large values of the coefficients, which can help prevent overfitting by encouraging simpler models.
